# FLX-3110: the supplied profile is not the one the Simulation pins

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The digest of the profile handed to plan, verify or ship (jcs-document: sha256 over its RFC 8785 canonical form) differs from the digest the Simulation pins. Either the profile changed after it was pinned, or it is a different profile. Pin the new digest in the Simulation if the change is intended, or pass the profile that was pinned. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3110
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
